instruction.name: xvmin.hu
instruction.description: Compute elementwise minimum for corresponding unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmin.hu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvmin.hu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvmin.hu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvmin.hu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvmin.hu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvmin.hu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvmin.hu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvmin.hu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
